implementation: Flutter now exposes microphone capture failure after falling back to listener mode, marks the local microphone unavailable in participant UI, and provides a retry action in VAD mode. In PTT mode the notice instructs the user to hold the assigned key and does not bypass the PTT gesture.

checks.name: Microphone fallback notice and PTT behavior
checks.observation: Widget tests verify listener-mode explanation, accessible retry, retry callback, and the PTT-specific instruction with no unguarded retry button.

checks.name: Voice participant workspace integration
checks.command: flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name "shows a retryable microphone-unavailable listener state"
checks.observation: Workspace test verifies the joined listener state presents the notice, local unavailable status, and retry action without layout exceptions.

checks.name: Microphone permission denial on native devices
checks.reason: Requires verifying platform-specific permission errors and retry after granting access on Android, macOS and Windows hardware.

remaining: Verify denied permission and post-grant retry on native devices; broader permission-denied copy/accessibility acceptance remains open in the parity checklist.
